name: Interface
description: Windows MDM settings in the Interface category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Disable Internal ID Matching (User)
properties.description: Prevent internal id matching. If you enable this setting, Project will not use internal identifiers to match different-language or renamed Organizer items between projects. If this setting is disabled or not configured, internal identifiers will be used to match different-language or renamed Organizer items between projects.
